definitions.explanation: A flat floating platform made of logs, bamboo or planks tied together, used to cross water or, in the past, to float timber down rivers.

examples.english: To go down the river on a raft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{筏|いかだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The children built a raft out of bamboo.
In the old days, logs cut in the mountains were bound into rafts and floated down the river.
